content.short: JokeRace is an on-chain contest platform used by top DAOs for hackathons, grants, and reputation building.
content.description: JokeRace is a premier on-chain contest and governance protocol designed to empower decentralized communities through structured competition and reputation building. Used by prominent projects like Polygon and Farcaster, the platform allows DAOs to run hackathons and grant programs in a transparent manner. Unlike traditional token-weighted systems, JokeRace emphasizes on-chain reputation and meritocratic governance. The protocol features unique 'Vote and Earn' mechanics to incentivize active participation, helping DAOs coordinate, reward, and recognize their most valuable members.
content.meta: JokeRace provides on-chain contest tools and reputation-based governance for DAOs. Discover JokeRace and other DAO Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
